head: bcdb98e1140e718a15d841ab19f9192c4aa0c65e
decision: Feasible with a separately selected/frozen phase and one optional shared system-prompt suffix. Do not edit the legacy common_instructions function, existing plans or budget hook. No implementation or experimental authorization is implied.

evidence: run.py:23-58 defines frozen base/root/completion prompt text
run.py:347 and :495 independently call the same common_instructions function for actual command and manifest
architecture_phase.py:48-68 checks the remote base and exact common-instruction/hook hashes
architecture_phase.py:69-101 binds q004 task/source/assets and one baseline-then-zg pair
ci_run.py:190-247 and workflow lines64-129 gate selection/plan before setup/provider
run.py:309-316 is the sole existing PreToolUse budget hook; :517-535 runs the pair and retains errors
key_constraint.implication: Directly appending new advice to COMMON_INSTRUCTIONS/common_instructions would change every legacy run and fail frozen remote/architecture gates. New final-answer verification must be an opt-in, separately hashed effective prompt. A new Stop hook or second critique/repair invocation is unnecessary and changes the call protocol.

selection.legacy_selection: All current combinations retain exact acceptance/task expansion when the new flag is false or absent. Original architecture_pilot=true remains the original architecture-v1 plan. Reject simultaneous old architecture and new verification flags, or new flag on any other task/phase.

recommended_minimum_design.isolated_module: Add answer_verification_phase.py with a pure selection validator, fixed suffix loader/composer and new-plan validator. A small architecture-family resolver returns a frozen execution spec for original q004 or the new q004 variant. Keep legacy architecture_phase.validate_plan unchanged and delegate original mode to it. No generic phase framework or migration of unrelated phases is needed.
recommended_minimum_design.integration: Resolve that spec once before provider/setup. ci_run uses its fields at the existing q004 source/remote-plan/metadata/runner-argument points instead of adding answer_verification_pilot checks to each branch. Workflow calls the same pure selection/plan gates and routes the existing embedding environment for the new mode. Preserve both fork guards and current provider/setup order.
recommended_minimum_design.prompt_composition: Leave common_instructions signature/body/constants byte-identical. Add one effective-instructions helper that calls it and returns its exact bytes when off, or base + a documented fixed separator + the fixed generic suffix bytes when on. Use the same computed effective string for run_trial command and manifest. Use getattr(..., False) where existing fixture Namespaces may lack the new attribute. No arm name, model result, task-specific data or runtime state enters composition.
recommended_minimum_design.instruction_asset: Add an immutable UTF-8 instructions/shared-answer-verification-v1.txt only after diagnosis selects exact generic wording. Read the known asset at controller side, not a user-supplied arbitrary file. Freeze both raw file SHA and effective composed prompt SHA, including separator/newline semantics. Do not rewrite the question prompt.txt or copy this asset into indexed source.
recommended_minimum_design.hooks: No hook additions or modifications. tool_budget.py, PreToolUse matcher, 24 admissions/600-second deadline, 30-turn/900-second total limits and 2000-second outer runner timeout remain unchanged.
recommended_minimum_design.call_scope: One baseline and one zg solver invocation, original provider probe/setup/preflight only; no appended validation chat, automatic repair, extra judge/model call or mandatory tool call. A changed prompt cannot guarantee identical realized tool/API call counts because model trajectories vary; the defensible invariant is unchanged caps, planned trial count and no harness-generated extra calls.

production_file_scope.change: Add default-off new input, route pure exclusive selection and new frozen-plan gate before provider, map existing embedding secret/endpoint env to the new phase, pass one new ci flag. Keep fork-only guards, job budget, original phase defaults and artifact retention unchanged.

Parse new flag; resolve original/new q004 spec once; select new frozen plan/phase metadata and pass optional runner flag. Reuse existing corpus export, upstream hash checks, remote authorization/index/readiness/identity/seed scan, vector preflight, pair execution and collection. Original modes serialize exactly the same command/metadata fields when new flag is off.

Parse one default-off fixed-policy switch; compute effective shared instructions once and use it for both profile commands and manifest. Only enabled mode adds a policy provenance block. Keep base prompt function, task prompt, all tools/limits/loop/parser-accounting/error behavior unchanged.
New isolated small module described above; delayed run.common_instructions import in validation avoids top-level import cycles. Accept base string in the pure composer.
New generic suffix, exact text pending; do not create/freeze until cross-case diagnosis is complete.
New standalone plan, separate phase/experiment identity and post-observation disclosure; initially unfrozen if/when authorized. Keep original architecture plan and outcomes intact.
New bounded offline contract tests using existing mocked subprocess and temporary fixture patterns. No live model CI needed to prove wiring.

must_remain_byte_identical: All older experiment JSON files including experiment-architecture-v1.json
Old raw results, rubric rules and phase-specific success criteria

new_plan_validation.delegate_base_gate: Call unchanged architecture_phase.validate_plan on the frozen base, then verify the new base reference points to that exact file and hash. This retains source/dataset/rubric/hook/common/runtime validation without weakening its hard-coded identity.
strict_inheritance: retrieval (a424 Rust package/native MCP schema/model/endpoint/config source hashes)
allowed_changes_only: one new exact run-input vector and separate run/output identity
generic shared suffix policy reference and effective prompt hash

new_prompt_hash_fields.common_instructions_sha256: new effective complete system suffix, pending exact instruction bytes
new_prompt_hash_fields.separator: freeze exact choice, e.g. two LF bytes; do not silently strip/normalize

new_plan_validation.run_plan: Exact one pair, start_repeat=1, repeats=1, trial_count=2, order baseline→zg, no automatic repeat/task expansion/outcome replacement, same job/runner limits. Input choices must select only the new flag with the common q004+completion requirements.
new_plan_validation.failure_modes: Reject missing/empty suffix, wrong UTF-8 or hash, asset path escape, malformed or unfrozen plan, inherited drift, wrong effective prompt hash, incorrect task/flags/repeats before provider calls/work creation. Frozen SHA plus independent text review provides genericity; a blacklist alone cannot prove no task-specific hints.

evidence_and_artifact_contract.manifest_when_off: Exactly old common_instructions field and old manifest key set; no optional-null policy metadata added to historical modes.
evidence_and_artifact_contract.manifest_when_on: Actual effective instructions in common_instructions; a new optional policy block records version, asset path/hash, base hash, effective hash and applies_identically_to=[baseline,zg]. command.json must show identical actual appended strings in both arms.
evidence_and_artifact_contract.reports: Copy new plan plus unchanged dataset as already done. Optionally copy the frozen suffix directly into reports as answer-verification-instructions.txt only for this phase; existing collector already redacts/retains reports, so TOP_ARTIFACT_FILES need not change. Keep prompt.txt equal to the unchanged question bytes.
evidence_and_artifact_contract.storage: Separate workflow run and archive directory/phase identity, never overwrite architecture-v1. Keep both planned outcomes and partial artifacts. Do not call the new phase a confirmation or merge its outcome into the original pair.
evidence_and_artifact_contract.provenance: Record code SHA/diff and new policy/base/effective prompt hashes at freeze; no need to change Rust/native schema/tool descriptions or provider configuration.

minimum_offline_tests.test: Legacy prompt bytes and frozen assets
minimum_offline_tests.proof: Compare old snapshot and new code common_instructions for V1, root-v2 and completion-v2. Assert the existing known hashes below remain exact; all original frozen plans/assets and hook files remain byte-identical. Existing architecture/remote validators still accept original frozen plans.

Differentially execute current workflow selector and ci wrapper snapshot versus modified code with the new flag absent/false across the complete old task×flag×repeat matrix, including original q004. Freeze/mock temp paths, UUID, time, UID and subprocess I/O; compare acceptance/task selection, old solver commands and old manifest/setup fields byte-for-byte. Do not normalize away prompt/env/tool/limit differences.

minimum_offline_tests.test: New exclusive selection before side effects
minimum_offline_tests.proof: For new flag=true, accept only exact q004/completion/new-phase input vector and repeat1; reject old architecture plus new mode, wrong tasks/root/confirmation/remote/expansion/repeats. Mock provider/setup calls to fail if reached on invalid/unfrozen input, and assert no work directory is created.

minimum_offline_tests.test: New plan and policy drift fail closed
minimum_offline_tests.proof: Mutate base plan/hash, task/question/rubric/dataset/source, any inherited runtime/agent/budget/preflight/evaluation field, suffix bytes/path/hash, effective prompt hash, order/count/repeats. Reject each before provider/setup. Accept one synthetic frozen fixture with generic placeholder suffix; the actual final text still needs independent review.

minimum_offline_tests.test: Symmetric actual runner command, unchanged question
minimum_offline_tests.proof: Reuse test_remote_embedding.py:284-310 mocked Popen fixture for both profiles. Capture complete --append-system-prompt strings and assert both equal old completion text plus exactly one frozen suffix; question bytes unchanged; command differences outside intentional arm isolation match old snapshot. Manifest effective text/hash equals both commands.

minimum_offline_tests.test: No added calls or resource changes
minimum_offline_tests.proof: Mock complete pair path and assert exactly two run_trial/Popen solver launches in baseline→zg order, original grant/index/probe call sequence, no critique/repair invocation, same max-turns/timeout/output/effort/24/600 flags and unchanged hook command/hash. Existing budget tests cover refusal and idempotency; no new hook behavior is introduced.

Same mocked fixture asserts baseline gets no embedding env/index/home seed/MCP; zg remains unchanged. Force partial/infrastructure failure and verify the new plan/policy/partial outputs are retained without private seeds, automatic replay or quality-dependent replacement.

optional_pre_freeze_runtime_check: If useful after implementation, an offline fake-provider fixture may capture both arms system text using installed pinned Claude; it must perform zero external inference and add no required live run. Command-capture unit tests above are the minimum wiring proof, not proof that a model follows the instruction.

instruction_content_constraints.allowed: Generic final-answer claim/source alignment and explicit uncertainty based on available evidence; exact wording pending cross-case diagnosis.
disallowed: code paths, source symbols, pool/adapter/builder/converter or count-specific hints
rubric criterion names, gold claims, prior error excerpts or preferred answer structure derived from q004
mandatory new searches, extra turns or separate model verification
instructions to bypass or extend the frozen tool budget
instruction_content_constraints.qualification: A same-session instruction can consume existing reasoning/output/time budget and can change actual tool choices; it cannot guarantee correctness, completion, equal actual call counts or lower cost.

limitations: This report is feasibility only. No text is selected, no code/test implementation was made, no new plan exists or is frozen, and no run was dispatched.
Exact suffix validity and the research reason for using it depend on the ongoing cross-case diagnosis; implementation isolation alone does not establish scientific value.
No additional result/answer/grade inspection was needed for this implementation task.
